panels.description: Revenue after line-level discounts for the selected business filters.

targets.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS
(
    SELECT
        f.*,
        ifNull(c.company_name, 'Unknown') AS company_name,
        ifNull(p.product_name, 'Unknown') AS product_name,
        ifNull(p.category_name, 'Unknown') AS category_name,
        ifNull(g.country, 'Unknown') AS country,
        toDate(parseDateTimeBestEffort(toString(f.order_date_key))) AS order_date,
        toFloat64(f.unit_price) * f.quantity * (1 - toFloat64(f.discount)) AS revenue
    FROM (SELECT * FROM northwind_dw.fact_orders FINAL WHERE is_deleted = 0) AS f
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM northwind_dw.dim_customer FINAL WHERE is_deleted = 0) AS c
        ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM northwind_dw.dim_products FINAL WHERE is_deleted = 0) AS p
        ON f.product_key = p.product_key
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM northwind_dw.dim_geography FINAL WHERE is_deleted = 0) AS g
        ON f.geography_key = g.geography_key
    WHERE ('${year}' = 'All' OR toString(intDiv(f.order_date_key, 10000)) = '${year}')
      AND ('${country}' = 'All' OR ifNull(g.country, 'Unknown') = '${country}')
      AND ('${category}' = 'All' OR ifNull(p.category_name, 'Unknown') = '${category}')
)
SELECT round(sum(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM filtered

targets.rawSql: SELECT entity, active_rows, deleted_rows, round(100 * active_rows / nullIf(active_rows + deleted_rows, 0), 2) AS active_ratio FROM (SELECT 'Customers' AS entity, countIf(is_deleted = 0) AS active_rows, countIf(is_deleted = 1) AS deleted_rows FROM northwind_dw.dim_customer FINAL UNION ALL SELECT 'Products', countIf(is_deleted = 0), countIf(is_deleted = 1) FROM northwind_dw.dim_products FINAL UNION ALL SELECT 'Order Lines', countIf(is_deleted = 0), countIf(is_deleted = 1) FROM northwind_dw.fact_orders FINAL) ORDER BY entity
